points.description: States the ZOH discretisation formulae before substituting: F = e^{AT} and G = (∫₀ᵀ e^{Aτ} dτ)·B (or equivalent G = A^{-1}(F − I)B). Both F and G formulae must be given. Stating Euler or Tustin formulae does not earn this mark.

levels.says: Only one of the two formulae (F or G) is stated correctly.

points.description: Correct F = e^{-0.2} = 0.8187 (accept 0.819, 0.81873). Euler value 0.8 is wrong.

levels.says: Correct exponent e^{-0.2} written but not evaluated numerically.

points.description: Correct G = (1 − e^{-0.2})/2 = 0.0906 (accept 0.09063). Sign-inverted (−0.0906) or Euler value 0.1 is wrong.

rubric.notes: Full marks: both formulae stated, F ≈ 0.8187 and G ≈ 0.0906. Only F given: 2 marks. Forward Euler (F=0.8, G=0.1) or Tustin, if clearly labelled, earns 1 mark maximum in total. Sign error giving G = −0.0906 keeps formula and F marks (2 total). Correct method with F and G left unevaluated: 1.5 maximum, but if it amounts to Euler, 1 maximum.
